definition: Invoice received without a valid purchase order reference
root_cause: Non-PO spend, PO not quoted on invoice, procurement bypass
resolution: Obtain PO retroactively or route for non-PO approval per policy

definition: PO reference exists but is not valid for this invoice
root_cause: Wrong PO quoted, PO for different supplier/entity
resolution: Identify correct PO or request new PO

definition: Referenced PO is closed and cannot accept further invoices
root_cause: Late invoice, PO prematurely closed, partial delivery complete
resolution: Reopen PO or create new PO per policy

definition: PO has insufficient remaining value or quantity
root_cause: Over-invoicing, partial deliveries, PO not updated

definition: Invoice price differs from PO price beyond tolerance
root_cause: Price change, incorrect PO price, currency issue
resolution: Approve variance, amend PO, or reject invoice

definition: Invoiced quantity differs from PO/receipt quantity
root_cause: Partial delivery, over-billing, unit of measure error
resolution: Match to receipt, adjust, or query supplier

definition: Goods or services receipt not recorded for PO invoice
root_cause: Receiver delay, system gap, services not receipted
resolution: Obtain goods receipt or service confirmation

definition: Receipt exists but quantity is less than invoiced
root_cause: Partial delivery, backorder, timing difference
resolution: Match to receipt qty, hold balance, or query supplier

definition: Exact duplicate of previously processed invoice
root_cause: Supplier resubmission, system duplicate, split submission
resolution: Reject duplicate, request credit if paid

definition: Near-duplicate suggesting possible double billing
root_cause: Similar invoice number, amount, date proximity

definition: Invoice supplier does not match PO or master data
root_cause: Supplier change, intercompany confusion, data error

definition: Invoice routed to wrong company code or legal entity
root_cause: Multi-entity supplier, routing error, intercompany

definition: GST/VAT/sales tax incorrect or missing
root_cause: Tax code error, exempt misclassification, rate change
resolution: Correct tax coding or query supplier

definition: Required approval not obtained per DOA
root_cause: Workflow gap, approver bypass, routing error

definition: Delegation of authority gap or misconfiguration
root_cause: Approver absent, delegation expired, limit exceeded

definition: GL/cost centre/project coding not provided
root_cause: Non-PO invoice, incomplete intake, requester omission
resolution: Obtain coding from requester or default per policy

definition: Cost centre code invalid, closed, or unauthorised
root_cause: Master data error, closed CC, policy violation
resolution: Correct coding with valid cost centre

definition: Document unreadable, incomplete, or non-compliant
root_cause: Poor scan, missing pages, non-standard format

definition: Automated extraction failed or low confidence
root_cause: Poor image quality, unusual format, handwriting

definition: Supplier, item, or reference data incorrect or missing
root_cause: Stale master data, onboarding gap, duplicate vendors

definition: Supplier bank details changed recently or differ from master
root_cause: Legitimate change, fraud attempt, data error
resolution: Verify change through approved channel before payment

definition: Overpayment or incorrect charge requires supplier credit
root_cause: Duplicate payment, pricing error, return

definition: Supplier statement does not match AP records
root_cause: Timing, missing invoice, unrecorded payment/credit

definition: Invoice or payment blocked by hold rule
root_cause: Dispute, compliance, approval gap, manual hold

definition: Business disputes validity or amount of invoice
root_cause: Quality issue, contract dispute, unauthorised purchase

definition: Exception open beyond defined SLA
root_cause: Any unresolved exception exceeding aging threshold
resolution: Escalate, resolve, or write off per policy

definition: Technical failure in integration or processing
root_cause: API failure, mapping error, timeout, data corruption
